headline: Executive order creates the Kosovo Campaign Medal, a military award for service related to the conflict in Kosovo.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Bill Clinton, creates a new military medal called the Kosovo Campaign Medal. It is meant to recognize members of the U.S. armed forces who served in military operations related to Kosovo. The title alone does not spell out who qualifies, the exact service dates, or how the medal is awarded.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the U.S. armed forces who served in Kosovo-related operations
who_it_affects.how: They may become eligible to receive the new Kosovo Campaign Medal, depending on rules not described in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 3, 2000; the title does not state a separate effective date.
